about: Every published model, its current version and every version it has had. A pin on a superseded version keeps resolving through Open Resource where a snapshot exists; only the current version's interface is published here.

models.name: algebra-tiles
models.title: Algebra tiles
models.tagline: x²/x/unit algebra tiles in positive/negative colours, as a collection or a rectangle; the collected expression, zero pairs and rectangle area/factors are derived by counting.

models.name: area-model
models.title: Area model
models.tagline: Rectangle split by two factors into partial-product cells with a derived total; cells, sides and total occlude for multiplying, the grid method or factorising.

models.name: balance-hanger
models.title: Balance hanger
models.tagline: Equation as a hanger diagram: labelled shapes hang either side of a pivoted beam; equation, solution and numeric tilt derived; shapes occlude, strike and highlight.

models.name: balance-scales
models.title: Balance scales (equations)
models.tagline: Linear equation as a level two-pan balance of boxes and unit weights; derives the equation, the solution and same-to-both-sides steps for solving.

models.name: differences-table
models.title: Sequence differences table
models.tagline: Method-of-differences table for sequences; derives each difference row, the degree (linear/quadratic/cubic) and the nth term exactly; cells occlude to question.

models.name: function-machine
models.title: Function machine
models.tagline: Input flows through operation boxes to an output; runs forward or backward, derives running values, occludes a terminal or a whole box ("complete the machine"), forms equations.

models.name: graph-table
models.title: Table of values & graph
models.tagline: Table of values for y=f(x) above a mini grid plotting the same points; y-values, joining curve and a differences row derived; occlude a column to question.

models.name: iteration-cobweb
models.title: Iteration (staircase / cobweb) diagram
models.tagline: Staircase/cobweb diagram for xₙ₊₁=g(xₙ): y=x, the curve and a zig-zag walking toward or away from the fixed point; every iterate derived.

models.name: number-pyramid
models.title: Number pyramid
models.tagline: Brick pyramid where each brick is the sum (or difference) of the two below; numeric or algebraic; bricks occlude for complete, find-the-top or work-back puzzles.

models.name: sequence-pattern
models.title: Sequence pattern
models.tagline: Pictorial growing sequence of dots/squares with counts and the nth-term link; linear, square, triangular or a shaped two-colour motif; predicts far terms, occludes for questions.

models.name: food-web
models.title: Food chain / food web
models.tagline: Food chain / web — organisms joined by energy-flow arrows (prey → predator); trophic levels, roles and remove-a-species knock-on all derived; labels and roles occludable.

models.name: punnett-square
models.title: Punnett square
models.tagline: Punnett square for a monohybrid or dihybrid cross: gametes head the axes, every offspring cell and the genotype/phenotype ratios are derived; cells, gametes and ratios occlude.

models.name: dot-and-cross
models.title: Dot-and-cross diagram (bonding)
models.tagline: Dot-and-cross bonding diagram derived from the formula — shells, shared pairs, transferred electrons and ion charges all computed; electrons and charges occludable.

models.name: energy-profile
models.title: Reaction energy profile
models.tagline: Reaction energy profile: reactant and product levels, with the peak, ΔH and the exo/endothermic verdict derived; optional catalyst curve at a lower Ea; readouts occludable.

models.name: particle-model
models.title: Particle model (states of matter)
models.tagline: Container of particles whose arrangement and spacing derive from the state — solid lattice, close liquid, sparse gas; state from substance + temperature, name occludable.

models.name: binary-converter
models.title: Binary converter
models.tagline: Binary place-value board (128 64 32 ... 1, 4/8/16-bit) with toggleable bits and a derived denary, hex and binary readout; bits, total and hex occlude for conversion questions.

models.name: blocks-editor
models.title: Block programming
models.tagline: Block programs that really run, Scratch-grade: sprites, events, loops, clones, sound, lists and custom blocks; task-sized toolbox, Parsons tray, run-marked answers.

models.name: caesar-cipher
models.title: Caesar cipher
models.tagline: Caesar cipher: an authored message + shift with the encoded/decoded twin, A→D mapping strip and letter-frequency bars all derived; occlude the shift, output or mapping.

models.name: cells
models.title: Data structure cells
models.tagline: Cell array with pointers stepped through queue, stack, list, hash and linked-list operations; contents, pointers, hashes and returns derived; occluded slots auto-marked.

models.name: code-editor
models.title: Code editor
models.tagline: Interactive Python or JavaScript editor with a run console, in seven colour themes; output is produced by running the code, so it cannot show a result the code would not.

models.name: er-diagram
models.title: Entity-relationship diagram
models.tagline: Entity boxes joined by cardinality-marked relationship lines, or the relations written out; foreign keys, link-entity composite keys and the 1NF/2NF/3NF table sets all derived.

models.name: graph
models.title: Graph (network)
models.tagline: Nodes and edges with the adjacency matrix, adjacency list, array encoding, degrees and a stepped depth-first / breadth-first / Dijkstra run all derived from one edge set.

models.name: logic-gates
models.title: Logic gates
models.tagline: Logic-gate circuit (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR) with wire states and truth table derived by evaluating it; occludable cells, mystery gates, blank-canvas answer space.

models.name: pixel-grid
models.title: Pixel grid
models.tagline: Bitmap image as its stored numbers: a code grid beside the picture those codes look up, with derived resolution, colour depth and file size; either side blanks for the question.

models.name: pseudocode-editor
models.title: Pseudo-code editor
models.tagline: Editable AQA pseudo-code listing that really runs: Run/Step/Reset, live variables, output where USERINPUT waits for the pupil; occlude for predict-the-output; run-program marking.

models.name: sampling
models.title: Sampling and quantisation
models.tagline: Analogue curve, its sample instants and the derived quantised staircase against the level grid; sample rate, bit depth, levels and file size derived and occludable.

models.name: spreadsheet
models.title: Spreadsheet
models.tagline: Interactive spreadsheet with a real recalc engine: $ refs with fill and copy/paste, COUNTIF/SUMIF, VLOOKUP, pupil formatting — it cannot show a value its formulas would not give.

models.name: sql-playground
models.title: SQL playground
models.tagline: Runnable SQL over small named tables: SELECT with aggregates, GROUP BY and JOIN … ON, DDL/DML that really changes the drawn tables, and marked before/after statement views.

models.name: state-machine
models.title: State machine
models.tagline: States + labelled transitions with the transition table, δ rules, run trace, accept/reject verdict and Turing tape all derived from one authored rule set; every cell occludable.

models.name: trace-table
models.title: Trace table
models.tagline: Trace table of an AQA pseudo-code or Python program: columns are variables, rows are steps, every cell executed not authored; cells occlude for "complete the trace".

models.name: turtle
models.title: Turtle graphics
models.tagline: Turtle editor beside a canvas, in Python 3 or classroom LOGO: loops, procedures, variables, arithmetic. Run executes the program, so the drawing comes from the code, not an author.

models.name: concept-map
models.title: Concept map
models.tagline: Concept map — concept boxes joined by labelled directed links (the relationship on each arrow); auto-laid-out free graph, any node or link label occludable.

models.name: cycle
models.title: Cycle
models.tagline: Ring of sequenced nodes joined by directed arrows that loop back to the start — life cycles, water/rock cycle; optional photo per node, positions and arrows all derived.

models.name: decision-walk
models.title: Decision walk (branching scenario)
models.tagline: Branching 'choose-your-path' scenario — labelled options lead to outcome cards; drawn as a branching tree, static or staged; labels occludable.

models.name: etymology
models.title: Etymology breakdown
models.tagline: A word split into morphemes under a bracket, each with its meaning and origin; bracket and columns derived, any meaning occludes for a question.

models.name: flowchart
models.title: Flowchart
models.tagline: Decision/flow diagram — start, process, decision and input-output boxes joined by directed arrows with Yes/No branches; auto-laid-out, every box occludable.

models.name: frayer
models.title: Frayer model
models.tagline: Frayer model: a central concept title above a 2×2 grid of four quadrants (Definition, Characteristics, Examples, Non-examples, or custom); bodies occlude as an answer space.

models.name: mind-map
models.title: Mind map
models.tagline: Hub-and-spoke mind map — a central idea ringed by labelled branch boxes on spokes; even radial auto-layout, branches occludable, reveal them one at a time.

models.name: pyramid
models.title: Pyramid (stacked tiers)
models.tagline: Stacked-triangle pyramid of labelled tiers from a broad base to a narrow tip; equal or value-proportional heights, derived percentages, occludable labels/values, invertible.

models.name: timeline
models.title: Timeline
models.tagline: Dated event cards along a line — evenly spaced (ordinal) or by date (scaled, gaps meaningful); optional photos and era bands; positions and ticks derived, events occludable.

models.name: tree
models.title: Tree (hierarchy)
models.tagline: Top-down hierarchy tree — a root and its branching children as labelled boxes joined by connectors; tidy auto-layout, optional Yes/No edge labels, every box occludable.

models.name: choropleth
models.title: Choropleth map
models.tagline: Choropleth map from the plate atlas: regions shaded by your data through a derived class scale and key; occlude a value or blank a shade to question it; two panels share one scale.

models.name: map-extract
models.title: Map extract
models.tagline: Exam-style map extract from the plate atlas: numbered km grid, derived contours, 4/6-figure refs; refs occlude into questions.

models.name: angle-estimator
models.title: Angle estimator
models.tagline: One angle from two rays at an authored size, for estimating by eye and classifying (acute/right/obtuse/reflex/straight); size and type derived, reading occludable, guides optional.

models.name: angles-at-a-point
models.title: Angles at a point
models.tagline: Rays meeting at a point with marked angle arcs — angles at a point (360°), on a line (180°) and vertically opposite, with algebraic labels; angles derived.

models.name: area-grid
models.title: Area on squared paper
models.tagline: A shape on squared paper with its cells shaded and counted (whole and half squares) for area as counting; the outline, tally and area are derived and the area occludes.

models.name: bearings
models.title: Bearings
models.tagline: Map points joined by paths with north lines and clockwise three-figure bearing arcs; bearings and back bearings derived from positions, always to scale.

models.name: circle-parts
models.title: Circle: parts, sectors and regions
models.tagline: A circle with named parts and derived measures; plus isolated sectors, annuli and composite sector/triangle regions — lettered, edge-dimensioned, right-angle marked, shaded or not.

models.name: circle-theorems
models.title: Circle geometry
models.tagline: Circle with named points, chords, radii and tangents and computed angle marks; presets for the standard circle theorems, every value derived from the geometry.

models.name: clock
models.title: Clock face
models.tagline: Analogue clock with hands placed faithfully from a time (3:30 is mid-way); derived angle arc between two arms in degrees or as a fraction of a turn.

models.name: composite-solid
models.title: Composite solid (isometric)
models.tagline: Coaxial composite of 2–3 solids (now incl. the frustum) — stacked, flipped, drilled or scooped; combined volume & surface area derived; optional assembled+exploded twin view.

models.name: compound-area
models.title: Compound area
models.tagline: Trapezium / triangle / compound 2-D shape drawn to scale from its outline; derived edge lengths, areas and an occludable perpendicular-height guide; totals summed; units optional.

models.name: congruence
models.title: Congruent triangles
models.tagline: Two named triangles with SSS/SAS/ASA/RHS marks — in a parent figure, on a circle, or free-standing; derives the matched pairs and criterion (the proof is block text).

models.name: construction
models.title: Ruler-and-compass construction
models.tagline: Ruler-and-compass construction — given points, swung arcs, crossings, the constructed line, locus or region; staged, every point derived; marked construct/draw answer.

models.name: digital-clock
models.title: Digital clock
models.tagline: Segmented digital time display (12-hr with am/pm or 24-hr) and a 12↔24 conversion table; period, 12-hr number and +12 link all derived, per-segment occlude.

models.name: exact-trig-table
models.title: Exact trig values table
models.tagline: Exact sin, cos and tan at 0–90° as a reference table, values rendered as stacked surds; degrees or radians; cells occlude for recall.

models.name: frustum
models.title: Cone frustum (truncated cone)
models.tagline: Conical frustum (truncated cone) drawn front-on — author R, r, h; derives the slant, the apex extension and the right-angled similar triangles for the difference-of-cones method.

models.name: geoboard
models.title: Geoboard
models.tagline: Peg board — square, isometric or circular pin-ring — with polygons formed by joining pegs; the band, fills and right-angle/parallel/equal-side marks all derived.

models.name: intersecting-lines
models.title: Intersecting lines
models.tagline: A web of straight lines through named points with a derived angle at every crossing; occlude, label or tick angles, flag lines parallel, shade the interior triangle.

models.name: isometric-cubes
models.title: Isometric cubes
models.tagline: Solid of unit cubes in isometric projection from a list of filled cells; faces tone-shaded, hidden cubes dropped; the cube or volume count occludes.

models.name: line-segment
models.title: Line segment
models.tagline: Bare horizontal line with ordered labelled collinear points, ticks and occludable length braces; each length derived from the ratio + one given length. Not a numeric axis.

models.name: net
models.title: Net of a solid
models.tagline: Net of a solid (cuboid, prism, pyramid, cylinder) and/or the solid it folds to; fold and cut edges, face areas and surface area derived; staged fold.

models.name: orthographic-views
models.title: Orthographic views (plan and elevations)
models.tagline: Plan/front/side views of a non-cube solid (rectangle, triangle, trapezium, circle, pentagon, polygon) on squared paper; dimensions derived, panels occludable, marked draw answer.

models.name: parallel-lines
models.title: Parallel lines and transversals
models.tagline: Parallel lines and transversals, derived marked angles — corresponding (F), alternate (Z), co-interior (C), the triangle angle-sum proof and a triangle spanning the parallels.

models.name: parallelogram-angles
models.title: Parallelogram angles
models.tagline: Parallelogram from three placed corners; interior angles derived (opposite equal, co-interior 180) plus optional extended-side triangle and diagonal-cevian angle-chase constructs.

models.name: plan-elevation
models.title: Plans and elevations
models.tagline: Cube solid in isometric beside its plan, front and side elevations, all derived from a height map; occlude a panel to question the others.

models.name: polygon-angle-table
models.title: Polygon angle table
models.tagline: Regular-polygon angle facts as a table — sides, interior sum, each interior, each exterior; one seed back-derives the rest both ways; cells occlude.

models.name: polygon-angles
models.title: Polygon angles
models.tagline: Single polygon with interior and/or exterior angles marked and the angle sum derived; regular or irregular, triangle-split, with algebraic-label questions.

models.name: polygons-at-a-point
models.title: Polygons at a point
models.tagline: Regular polygons fitted round a shared vertex, edge-to-edge; each interior angle at the point, the 360° gap and one unknown polygon's side count all derived.

models.name: prism
models.title: Prism (isometric)
models.tagline: Isometric prism — extrude any cross-section (regular, circle, sector, L-shape, arch) along a length; area/SA/volume derived; symbolic labels, vertex letters, drag to rotate.

models.name: protractor
models.title: Protractor
models.tagline: A protractor on an angle: dual 0–180 scale, measured arc, derived reading; occlude to measure, list sizes for a pie chart, construct: true for a marked draw-an-angle.

models.name: pythagoras-proof
models.title: Pythagoras' theorem (squares)
models.tagline: Right triangle with a square on each side and its area shown — the a²+b²=c² visual proof; hypotenuse and areas derived, square areas occlude.

models.name: quadrilateral
models.title: Quadrilateral
models.tagline: Quadrilateral from four vertices with derived sides, angles, right angles and an optional splitting diagonal for two-triangle Pythagoras figures; occludable/highlightable.

models.name: scale-drawing
models.title: Scale drawing
models.tagline: Figure drawn to scale with a scale statement and derived representative fraction; converts real↔drawn length both ways; bearing-and-distance routes.

models.name: scale-map
models.title: Scale map
models.tagline: Gridded map with a compass rose, landmark icons, a scale bar and a double number line; distances and 8-point directions between places are derived from the scale and occludable.

models.name: shape-dissection
models.title: Shape dissection
models.tagline: A polygon cut into named child-shape pieces, then rearranged by rigid moves into a same-area shape; piece areas, shape names and the area-conservation check are derived.

models.name: shape-on-grid
models.title: Shape on a centimetre grid
models.tagline: One rectangle, triangle or parallelogram on centimetre squared paper; sides, area, perimeter derived and occludable; drag-to-construct a shape obeying length/area/perimeter rules.

models.name: similar-shapes
models.title: Similar shapes
models.tagline: Two similar triangles — disjoint, nested (parallel line in a triangle) or bowtie (shared apex); derives every missing length + the area/volume factors; occlude the unknown.

models.name: similar-shapes-table
models.title: Similar shapes measurements table
models.tagline: Two or three similar shapes compared in a working table — shapes as columns, Length / Area / Volume as rows, with derived ×k / ×k² / ×k³ scale-factor arrows across the gaps.

models.name: similar-solids
models.title: Similar solids (pair)
models.tagline: a pair of similar 3-D solids (cylinder, cone, frustum, sphere) — B = k × A drawn genuinely larger; label the given dimension on A, B or both; area k², volume k³.

models.name: similarity-ratio-table
models.title: Similar shapes scale-factor table
models.tagline: Length, Area and Volume scale-factor table (k, k², k³); one factor back-derives the others exactly with surds; cells occlude for complete-the-table.

models.name: solid
models.title: 3D solid (isometric)
models.tagline: 3-D solid in isometric — 8 shapes; round by radius/diameter; cone by height/slant; derived volume, surface area, slant; symbolic labels; letter a pyramid ABCDE; drag-to-rotate.

models.name: symmetric-pattern
models.title: Symmetric pattern
models.tagline: Squared-paper grid: colour one half, the other reflects across a central vertical/horizontal/diagonal mirror; mirror cells derived, leave blank or tap to complete.

models.name: symmetry
models.title: Symmetry
models.tagline: Shape with its symmetry marked — dashed mirror lines and rotational order with a turn arrow; counts derived, occlude or hide for find-them / draw-them.

models.name: tiling-manipulative
models.title: Tangram & pattern blocks
models.tagline: A fixed canonical piece-set — the 7-piece tangram or the pattern blocks — placed to compose a figure; total area, fractions and the piece-equivalence relations all derived.

models.name: transformations
models.title: Transformations
models.tagline: Object and derived image on a grid under one transformation or a sequence; shapes nameable A/B; construct mode: pupils place the image's vertices, marked as an exact set.

models.name: triangle
models.title: Triangle
models.tagline: Single triangle from three vertices with angles, sides, ticks, right angles and altitude/cevians; colour-paired angle↔opposite-side annotation for sine/cosine/area-rule figures.

models.name: turn
models.title: Turn (amount of turn)
models.tagline: Amount of turn about a centre (quarter/half/three-quarter/full, clockwise or anticlockwise) as a sweep arrow, turn-dial or landmarks rosette; angle and fraction derived.

models.name: vector-proof-free
models.title: Vector proof (free figure)
models.tagline: Author any vector figure point-by-point — each point a position vector in {a, b}, joined by chosen edges; base arrows, amber segment highlighter, derived routes / k / collinearity.

models.name: vector-proof-preset
models.title: Vector proof (preset shapes)
models.tagline: Not-to-scale triangle/parallelogram/hexagon with base vectors a, b and symbolic points (ratio, midpoint, extended); derives routes in a,b, the scalar k, collinearity and reverse.

models.name: vectors
models.title: Vectors
models.tagline: Column vectors as arrows on a grid plus their algebra; scalar multiples and resultants drawn tip-to-tail or by the parallelogram rule, components derived.

models.name: area-under-curve
models.title: Area under a curve
models.tagline: Curve with the area to the x-axis shaded — definite integral, trapezium rule, area between curves, tangents; bare A Level sketch axes and parametric curves; values derived.

models.name: circle-graph
models.title: Circle on coordinate axes
models.tagline: A circle on numbered axes: derives the centre–radius equation, the tangent at a point (⊥ to the radius, exact equation) and where a line meets the circle.

models.name: conversion-graph
models.title: Conversion graph
models.tagline: straight-line unit-conversion graph on a numbered grid; line from a rate or two points; dashed read-off guides with derived, occludable values, or arm read-off to read one off.

models.name: coordinate-grid
models.title: Coordinate grid
models.tagline: Numbered coordinate grid: points, segments and lines x = k / y = k / y = mx + c, labels derived; place-point, select-point and place-line (draw the line) answers.

models.name: first-principles
models.title: Differentiation from first principles
models.tagline: Curve with a point, tangent and shrinking chords for first principles; gradients derived; draw-tangent answer mode (pivot a line until tangent) and science axis titles.

models.name: function-graph
models.title: Function graph
models.tagline: Curves y=f(x), parametric or anonymous sketches; numbered or bare axes; derives roots, turning points, asymptotes; sketch-curve auto-marks "sketch y = f(x)" from recall.

models.name: inequality-region
models.title: Graphical inequalities (regions)
models.tagline: Linear inequalities as boundary lines with the feasible region shaded; solid/dashed edges and integer solutions derived; pupils can shade, mark crosses or draw-then-shade.

models.name: journey-graph
models.title: Journey graph (distance–time / speed–time)
models.tagline: Piecewise motion graph from waypoints; derives each section's gradient and area; occlude to question, or arm draw-journey to draw it / read-off to read a value off it.

models.name: proportionality-graph
models.title: Proportionality sketch graph
models.tagline: unscaled sketch graphs of the four proportionality shapes (y∝x line, y∝1/x, y∝x², y∝1/x²) on labelled x–y axes with an O origin; one panel or a 2×2 A/B/C/D match grid.

models.name: transformation-explorer
models.title: Transformation explorer
models.tagline: Parent curve in grey + its derived image y = a·f(x−b)+c (with f(−x), −f(x) reflections); derived mapped points + arrows show the base-to-image correspondence.

models.name: balance-scale
models.title: Balance scale
models.tagline: Tilting beam / pan balance for comparing and ordering mass; the tilt, verdict and order are derived from authored masses, occlude for "which is heavier?".

models.name: measuring-scale
models.title: Measuring scale
models.tagline: Graduated instrument read against an indicator — ruler, capacity jug or dial scale; ticks and the reading derived, occlude to "?" for reading off.

models.name: force-diagram
models.title: Force diagram (statics and dynamics)
models.tagline: A Level free-body figure: a particle or block on a level, inclined, wall or ceiling scene with labelled force arrows and derived angle arcs; magnitudes optional, nothing resolved.

models.name: pulley-system
models.title: Connected particles over a pulley
models.tagline: Two particles on a taut string over a pulley — Atwood, table-edge or a wedge at a labelled angle; string path, wedge and angle arcs derived, masses and heights occludable.

models.name: rod
models.title: Rod (loaded beam and leaning ladder)
models.tagline: Rigid rod AB with named points, two or more supports (pivots, strings, pegs, a wall hinge), loads and dimension arrows from an end; horizontal beam or ladder leaning at θ.

models.name: score
models.title: Sheet music
models.tagline: Sheet music from ABC: any clef, key and time signature, multi-part systems, lyrics, chords, dynamics; accidentals, beams and bar numbers derived; bars occlude; pages by bar range.

models.name: array
models.title: Array
models.tagline: Discrete objects in rows×cols groups; derives the total, repeated-addition sentence, commutativity, factors and fraction of a set; a KS1/2 manipulative.

models.name: bar-model
models.title: Bar model
models.tagline: Singapore bar model — bars split into value or unit segments with braces; derives the unit value and unknown parts for part–whole, ratio and fractions.

models.name: bead-string
models.title: Bead string
models.tagline: Threaded beads clustered in fives and tens, a solid counted run against a faint remainder; derives the count, five-and-a-bit split, bonds and complements (incl. to 60 minutes).

models.name: column-arithmetic
models.title: Column arithmetic (written method)
models.tagline: Vertical written addition, subtraction and multiplication; derives every carry, borrow, partial product and the answer; staged a step at a time, plain or grid.

models.name: compound-growth-table
models.title: Compound growth & decay table
models.tagline: A period-by-period table for compound interest, depreciation and repeated % change: derived opening balance, ×(1±r) multiplier, interest and closing balance each year.

models.name: cuisenaire-rods
models.title: Cuisenaire rods
models.tagline: Coloured proportional rods in trains; length and colour from value, with derived totals, number sentences and fractions for iterating, comparing and building a whole.

models.name: double-number-line
models.title: Double number line
models.tagline: Two aligned 0-based scales in direct proportion; one correspondence derives the scaling and every partner value — recipes, rates, percentages, unitary.

models.name: fdp-table
models.title: Fraction, decimal & percentage table
models.tagline: Fraction–decimal–percentage equivalence table; write one form per row and the other two derive string-exact (recurring dots); cells occlude and rows sort by value.

models.name: fraction-shape
models.title: Fraction of a shape
models.tagline: Bar, circle or grid split into equal parts and shaded for a fraction; a common-denominator partition derived for adding, equivalence and of-amount.

models.name: fraction-wall
models.title: Fraction wall
models.tagline: Stacked bars of one whole split by denominator so equivalent fractions line up; derives equivalence, comparison and the common-denominator row.

models.name: gattegno-chart
models.title: Gattegno place-value chart
models.tagline: Powers-of-ten rows × digit columns 1–9; ring one cell per place to build a number (the sum), with ×10/÷10 shown as derived same-column row jumps.

models.name: metric-ladder
models.title: Metric conversion table
models.tagline: Metric unit conversion as a working table — unit rungs (length / mass / capacity) down the rows with derived ×k / ÷k power-of-ten arrows and the converted value.

models.name: money
models.title: Money (coins & notes)
models.tagline: UK coins (drawn chunky, real shapes & colours) and notes with a derived total; count a set, make an amount, and give change on a count-on skip-count track; £/p, occludable.

models.name: number-cards
models.title: Number cards
models.tagline: Row of bordered card tiles with authored faces (digits, numbers, letters, symbols); one to three labelled groups; cards occlude to "?", blank for answer spaces, highlight amber.

models.name: number-grid
models.title: Number grid
models.tagline: Hundred-square shaded by value rules — multiples, primes, sequences, remainders — with common-multiple overlap in amber; shaded sets derived, cells ring.

models.name: number-line
models.title: Number line
models.tagline: Horizontal number line with marked points, signed jumps and shaded open/closed intervals; answer on it — draw an inequality or mark a probability with a cross; positions derived.

models.name: number-shape
models.title: Number shape
models.tagline: Numicon-style pegged number shapes 1–10 (2-wide, odd numbers protrude a peg) as plates, cubes or counters; derives parity, number bonds and the stem sentence.

models.name: number-track
models.title: Number track
models.tagline: Row of contiguous numbered boxes holding a counting sequence; cell values and the step rule derived from start + step; cells occlude, blank, highlight or lift out as loose cards.

models.name: part-whole
models.title: Part-whole model
models.tagline: Part-whole "cherry" — a whole linked to 2–3 parts for number bonds and fact families; the omitted node derived (fractions too), any node occludes.

models.name: percentage-square
models.title: Percentage square
models.tagline: 10×10 hundred-square shaded for a percentage with derived decimal, fraction and multiplier; models increase/decrease and forward or reverse percentage.

models.name: percentage-table
models.title: Percentage table (benchmark ladder)
models.tagline: Of-amount percentage benchmark ladder (100% = amount, then 50% / 10% / 5% / 1% …); each value derived, ÷k/×k mental-step arrows, and a build-up to a target %.

models.name: place-value
models.title: Place value chart
models.tagline: Number in a power-of-ten place-value chart; ×/÷ by a power of ten drawn as derived digit shifts with a fixed point; standard form ↔ ordinary.

models.name: place-value-blocks
models.title: Place-value blocks
models.tagline: Place-value mat with Dienes, counters or bundles; derives the numeral, a stem sentence, subtraction and the exchange — the concrete→abstract bridge.

models.name: prime-factor-tree
models.title: Prime factor tree
models.tagline: Number split into a prime factor tree with primes ringed; derives the product in index or expanded form and, with a second tree, the HCF and LCM.

models.name: ratio-bars
models.title: Ratio bars
models.tagline: Ratio as equal-unit part-bars at simplified and actual scales joined by ×k/÷k arrows; derives the share value and every quantity from one known.

models.name: ratio-table
models.title: Ratio table
models.tagline: Ratio as a working table with scaled rows and ×k/÷k edge arrows; derives every cell, the factors and Total/Difference columns from one known value.

models.name: short-division
models.title: Short division (bus-stop method)
models.tagline: Division by the short (bus-stop) method; derives every quotient digit, carried remainders and the decimal by an exact engine; staged reveal, cells occlude.

models.name: ten-frame
models.title: Ten-frame
models.tagline: One or two 2×5 ten-frames with two-colour counters; derives the count, the colour bond and how-many-more-to-ten for bonds and bridging.

models.name: timetable
models.title: Timetable
models.tagline: Bus or train timetable grid of clock times; derives journey durations, gaps between services and the latest arrive-by with 60-base time arithmetic past midnight.

models.name: atom
models.title: Atom (shell model)
models.tagline: Bohr shell-model atom — nucleus counts, electron shells and configuration, all derived from the species; draws neutral atoms, ions and isotopes.

models.name: circuit
models.title: Circuit
models.tagline: Series / parallel circuit in BS/IEC symbols whose currents, pds, meter readings and bulb brightness are all derived by solving it; occludable readings, clickable switches.

models.name: forces
models.title: Force diagram (free body)
models.tagline: Free-body force diagram: labelled arrows from a body, lengths derived from newtons; resultant and balanced/unbalanced verdict always derived and occludable.

models.name: gear-train
models.title: Gear train
models.tagline: Meshed gears drawn to scale from their tooth counts; rotation directions, turns/rpm and the overall gear ratio derived, compound shaft pairs included; each occludes.

models.name: moments
models.title: Moments (levers and see-saws)
models.tagline: Beam on a pivot with weights (force N) at distances either side; moments F×d, side totals, the balance verdict and the tilt are derived; occlude a force or distance to solve.

models.name: ray-optics
models.title: Ray diagrams (mirror & lens)
models.tagline: Light ray diagrams: plane-mirror reflection (derived reflected ray, normal, equal angles) and convex-lens principal-ray construction with the derived image and its nature.

models.name: sankey
models.title: Sankey diagram
models.tagline: Energy-transfer Sankey diagram: input bar splits into useful/wasted branches, widths and efficiency derived from value; values occludable, useful branch highlightable.

models.name: wave-superposition
models.title: Wave superposition
models.tagline: Two sine waves and their derived point-by-point sum on one axis; constructive / destructive interference, phase difference, standing-wave nodes; sum occludable to "sketch it".

models.name: probability-table
models.title: Probability table
models.tagline: Discrete distribution table summing to 1; derives missing probabilities, expected frequency and a cumulative F(x) row; occluded cells show "?" or a named unknown (a, b).

models.name: relative-frequency
models.title: Relative frequency (experimental vs theoretical)
models.tagline: Experimental relative-frequency line settling toward an amber theoretical level; derives RF at each milestone and expected frequency; fair vs biased.

models.name: spinner
models.title: Spinner
models.tagline: Equal-sector spinner (circle or polygon) with repeatable labels and a pointer; derives each angle and P(label)=matching÷total as a simplified fraction.

models.name: tree
models.title: Tree diagram
models.tagline: Probability or frequency tree, 2–3 stages; labels every branch; derives the missing branch, end probabilities and totals; occludes; answer on the model to complete the tree.

models.name: venn
models.title: Venn diagram
models.tagline: 2- or 3-set Venn in a universal rectangle, circles standard/chain/disjoint/apart; regions carry values, stacked "a/b" fraction labels or member lists; ξ total suppressible.

models.name: averages-table
models.title: Averages from a frequency table
models.tagline: Frequency-table working surface; derives midpoint, f×x, cumulative f, mean, modal class, median; cells occlude to "?" or a symbol; open "4 or more" rows; both interval styles.

models.name: bar-chart
models.title: Bar chart
models.tagline: Bar chart of categorical data with separated bars; derives the value-axis scale, total and mode; a second series compares; occlude to read a value off, or draw the blank bars.

models.name: box-cf
models.title: Cumulative frequency & box plot
models.tagline: Cumulative-frequency curve and box plot on a shared axis; derives running totals, quartiles, IQR, the five-number summary and 1.5×IQR outliers; read off, compare, or draw the box.

models.name: carroll-diagram
models.title: Carroll diagram
models.tagline: Carroll sort grid (2×2, or 2×3 with a categorical axis): items placed into cells derived from two yes/no or numeric-rule properties; cells occlude/highlight, counts derived.

models.name: climate-graph
models.title: Climate graph
models.tagline: Climate graph (climograph): monthly rainfall bars on a left axis, a temperature line on a right axis; totals, means, ranges, wettest/hottest month all derived; readings occlude.

models.name: frequency-polygon
models.title: Frequency polygon
models.tagline: Frequency polygon of grouped data — derives midpoints, plots × at (midpoint, frequency) and joins; overlays up to three; occludable points; draw-it-on marking via place-derived.

models.name: frequency-tree
models.title: Frequency tree
models.tagline: Frequency tree: a count inside an ellipse node at each junction (root total → stage counts), category words on the branches; a missing count derives, any node occludes to "?".

models.name: histogram
models.title: Histogram
models.tagline: Histogram of grouped continuous data — height is frequency density, area is frequency; derives densities and sub-range frequency; can be drawn ON to answer "draw the histogram".

models.name: pictogram
models.title: Pictogram
models.tagline: Pictogram read against a key; part-symbols as wedges or grid cells; occlude a frequency or the KEY itself; blank rows complete on the model in quarter steps, auto-marked.

models.name: pie-chart
models.title: Pie chart
models.tagline: Pie chart of frequencies; derives total, multiplier, angles, percentages; occlude to find one; drag-to-construct; read-off schematic with right-angle & given-angle cues.

models.name: population-pyramid
models.title: Population pyramid
models.tagline: Population pyramid: back-to-back male/female age bands; widest cohort, dependency ratio and the youthful/ageing verdict derived; readings occlude, blank bars are drawn and marked.

models.name: sample-space-grid
models.title: Sample-space diagram
models.tagline: Two-event sample-space grid; each cell is the combined outcome and shaded events give P=matched÷total; values and probabilities derived, cells occlude.

models.name: scatter
models.title: Scatter graph
models.tagline: Scatter graph of bivariate data; derives line of best fit, correlation, outliers, estimates. @2 answer modes: plot-the-points, draw a line of best fit, read off an estimate.

models.name: stem-leaf
models.title: Stem-and-leaf diagram
models.tagline: Stem-and-leaf from raw data; derives stems, ordered leaves, key, median/mode/range; answer on the model — complete the leaves, or fully construct the stems, leaves and key.

models.name: tally-chart
models.title: Tally chart
models.tagline: Gated five-bar tally chart; marks derived from each row's count; occlude a frequency, mismatch one to pose the error, or draw a blank row's tally on the model, auto-marked.

models.name: time-series
models.title: Time-series graph
models.tagline: Time-series line graph; derives a centred moving average, a least-squares trend and season bands; series in blue, trend in teal; occlude to question.

models.name: two-way-table
models.title: Two-way table
models.tagline: Two-way frequency table with derived row, column and grand totals and an optional P(event) readout including conditional; cells and totals occlude.

models.name: calendar
models.title: Calendar
models.tagline: A one-month calendar grid whose day-count (leap rule) and the weekday of the 1st (derived) lay out the dates; mark dates and step this/next/last with wrap.

models.name: cycle-wheel
models.title: Cycle wheel
models.tagline: Periodic sequence as a labelled ring with a pointer — months, days of the week, seasons or a custom cycle; this/prev/next and step-and-wrap all derived.
